limitations: This aggregate evidence export supports inspection; it is not sufficient to regenerate the trained weights or reproduce per-case outcomes without separately acquiring data and training.
Original environment and data caches were removed after the experiment.
Historical acceptance/parity receipts are not newly executed tests of this sharing preparation.
numerical_policy: Copied recorded values without recomputing learned scores or rerunning model/benchmark code. Display rounding is unchanged from the local interpretation.
purpose: Portable sharing evidence for Stateful Python Code Completion; no new scientific execution.
source_paths_note: Paths under sources are historical project-relative provenance identifiers, not promised public-export files or hyperlinks. No machine-local absolute paths are included.
